svg.aria-label: LU factorization of A = (1 2 1; 3 8 1; 0 4 1). Subtracting 3 times row 1 from row 2 and then 2 times row 2 from row 3 turns A into U = (1 2 1; 0 2 -2; 0 0 5) with pivots 1, 2, 5. The multipliers 3, 0, 2 drop straight into L = (1 0 0; 3 1 0; 0 2 1), while the product E32 E21 = (1 0 0; -3 1 0; 6 -2 1) mixes them. A = LU.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Elimination is a factorization: A = LU
